name: evalroom batch (6b, Gate E signed 24 Oct 2026): the nine pictures left after the samples; Nutmeg's second pose waits for the engine to take poses. Level file levels/LEVEL-evalroom.md.
notes: Judged in the live room on the tablet, never as loose files (CLAUDE.md gate E). A failed sample goes back to its prompt, not to the batch.
Cut-outs are keyed on white, cropped and quantised with tools/lift.py's method; close-ups saved at 1920x1080 JPEG 88.

cases.prompt:
Style: a polished, finished illustration drawn for a game, not a picture book for toddlers; clean dark-ink outlines on everything, a shadow side on every object and soft cast shadows from one light source, so things sit solidly on their surfaces; smooth colour with gentle shading, a faint paper-grain texture and a gentle vignette at the edges. Bright and clear, not hazy or dark. The attached picture is a crop from the room this belongs to: copy only its style, hand and palette, not its objects. Draw it alone on a pure flat white background: no surface, no shadow on the ground, no frame, no border, no text, nothing else in the picture. The object fills most of the frame.

The object: a thirty-centimetre wooden school ruler with centimetre marks along one edge, a small bite missing from one corner, lying flat and level, seen from directly above. The marks are plain ticks with no numbers, no letters, nothing written on it.
cases.note: asset 2: the strip icon and the ruler in the drawer and by the plants

cases.prompt:

Bright and clear, not hazy or dark. The attached picture is a crop from the room this belongs to: copy only its style, hand and palette, not its objects. Palette of the room: cream walls over a pale mint band, pale wood floor, teal and purple accents, warm afternoon sun. A single picture that fills the whole 16:9 frame edge to edge: no border, no margin, no frame, no dark surround. No words, letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the picture.

The picture: four terracotta pots in a row on a white-painted window sill, seen straight on and close, the sill running along the bottom of the frame, each pot with a bean plant growing up a thin green cane: the first a bare shoot just above the soil, the second small, the third middling, the fourth tall, their tops at four clearly different heights rising left to right. Each pot has a plain blank white label stuck on its front. Behind them the window glass with soft afternoon sun and a blur of sky. Nothing written anywhere.
cases.note: asset 11: the game draws the labels' icons, the ruler and the heights
